I  have the same request as you, in order to have following :

. Backup solution to read sensor in case of blucon failure (battery, bt association)

. Be able to read backlog values from sensor for previous 8 hours  if  missed by blucon, or intentionnaly removed(bath, pool, sport activities).

. Have an alternative reader if smart phone is off(battery issue, forget device somewhere)... And collector does not work on SW3 (BT association fails, or other  unknown issue as in my case).

Librealarm is a complement  solution to xdrip when all is working. But does not fullfill previous cases.
It cannot display values on sw3.
It cannot  be tiggered on-demand, and controlled on sw3 (app is invisible !!!).

@filipedanunes Would you please close this issue if it has been resolved?
Otherwise, would you please update considering that xDrip has been updated considerably since then?
You can use the support channels to see if others may have any suggestions.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
Thanks
